name: Note Rueme
source: She is the first princess of the Celestial Realm, known by the title 'The Grand Luna' for her perfectly silver hair, which signifies that her magical potential is the highest possible for a member of the divine race.  She is something of a klutz outside of battle, and her personality (normally) is kind and gentle.  However, she is also capable of being coldly ruthless when the situation calls for it.  She is extremely weak to her sister Amia, who knows precisely how to push her buttons.
